EditTextPreference.android:title: API Key
EditTextPreference.android:summary: Paste your API key from the Ledger web app

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Only forward bank/UPI SMS
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Only forward messages containing a monetary value (e.g. Rs 500, INR 51.00) plus a transaction keyword. OTP messages are always skipped.

EditTextPreference.android:title: Monitored apps
EditTextPreference.android:summary: Comma-separated package IDs of fintech apps whose transaction notifications should be forwarded (e.g. Slice). Default: indwin.c3.shareapp

Preference.android:title: Grant notification access
Preference.android:summary: Required to read transaction alerts from apps like Slice that don't send regular SMS. Opens Android's Notification access settings.

Preference.android:title: Debug: log ALL notifications (10 min)
Preference.android:summary: Temporarily log every app's notifications so you can find an app's exact package ID. Check results in the Debug screen.

Preference.android:title: Open notification debug log
Preference.android:summary: See recent notifications the listener received and why each was forwarded or skipped.

Preference.android:title: Ledger SMS Forwarder
Preference.android:summary: Sends your bank/UPI transaction SMS to your Ledger expense tracker. Messages are parsed and stored for review - nothing is saved to your Ledger without your confirmation.
